briefdescription.para: Production implementation of approximation boundary and governance rules for layered retrieval (EPIC 2.4).

detaileddescription.para:
Implements DefaultApproximationRuleEngine, the concrete rule-engine that enforces per-layer approximation zones, Category C fail-closed rules, and dynamic policy overrides as defined in:
docs/EPIC2_APPROXIMATION_GOVERNANCE.md
docs/adr/adr-e2-004-approximation-governance-rules.md

sect2.title: Boundary enforcement overview
sect2.para: For each checkBoundary() call the engine evaluates rules in priority order:

listitem.para: Category C fail-closed — any Category C kernel on a non-Exact path is rejected immediately regardless of other policy settings.
GPU attempt on Exact layer — GPU dispatch to ExactGraph is rejected.
Zone/layer mismatch — requesting a looser zone than the canonical minimum for the layer triggers EscalateToExact.
Truth-bearing mismatch — approximate/bounded zone requested for a truth-bearing layer is rejected unless bypass is in effect.
Confidence threshold — confidence below the policy minimum for the requested zone triggers EscalateToExact (Exact zone) or Deny (Exact zone with confidence below 1.0).
Policy ACL / provenance / transaction override — known Category C workload types force Exact zone regardless of the requested zone.
Bypass — only applied when policy.allow_bypass == true and no Category C / GPU invariant was violated.
